snippet.title: Sagas of Lumin - Release Date Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
A release date trailer for Sagas of Lumin. Sagas of Lumin is a single-player action RPG. Take to the skies on the back of a dragon or battle on the ground with magic, melee weaposn and firearms. Sagas of Lumin is coming to PC in Summer 2026

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130220/Sagas_of_Lumin/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
